summary.overallAssessment: API performance validation is limited as the system is in mock/prototype stage. No production load testing was possible. Findings are based on code analysis and architectural review.

mockServiceLatency.mobileApiClient: No mock — real network calls with configurable timeout

backendLatency.identity-service: Direct JPA queries — expected <50ms per call
backendLatency.analysis: No caching layer, no connection pooling tuning, no query optimization evident

requestPayloads.largest: Workflow definitions, content generation requests — could exceed 1MB

issues: No retry with backoff (except mobile offline sync)

cachingAnalysis.httpCaching: No Cache-Control headers observed in controller responses
cachingAnalysis.applicationCaching: No @Cacheable annotations found in any service
cachingAnalysis.recommendation: Add Cache-Control headers for GET endpoints, implement Redis caching for frequently accessed data

retryBehavior.allOtherFrontends: No retry logic — single attempt, fail immediately
retryBehavior.recommendation: Add retry with exponential backoff to all API calls

networkValidation.compression: Not enforced — no Accept-Encoding headers configured

timeouts.webAppDashboards: Default fetch timeout (none — could hang indefinitely)

recommendations.action: Implement API Gateway with rate limiting and caching
Add pagination to all list endpoints
Configure Cache-Control headers on GET responses
Implement connection pooling tuning and query optimization
Add request timeout configuration to all frontend API calls
Implement circuit breakers for inter-service calls
